### Describe the bug

Firstly thank you to the Gradio team for the work on this amazing framework - it is one of the best GUI frameworks ever!

But ....

Every single release of Gradio 6 has broken working features and caused incredible performance regression since version 5.49.

We have been working on a project using Gradio for two years with extensive use of almost all Gradio components.

Every release of Gradio 6 has broken things - claiming to fix things and then spending days debugging things that worked before and finding workarounds - or not.

Something as simple as a full screen button on images - still not working

Accordion element - still broken even after 6.6.0 claiming fixed. [...] The list goes on and on.

Spent more time looking at the Issues page in Gradio than any other project on Github. Just want to keep working but it is one step forward and 2 back.

Please - if it works don't break it.

### Have you searched existing issues? 🔎

 I have searched and found no existing issues

results.title: Broken css reference breaks Gradio App
results.content: When a user publishes an app using the Gradio library, the UI renders unstyled. Root Cause: Gradio expects themes.css to load from the root URL: the stylesheet

results.title: Gradio Lite mostly dead on all Spaces? - Spaces - Hugging Face Forums
results.content:
Gradio-Lite is breaking on Spaces because Pyodide’s package installer (`micropip`) can only install pure-Python or Pyodide-built wheels. Recent dependency resolution pulls a `huggingface-hub` requirement that `micropip` refuses to install, so the app never boots. The failing traceback and version range (`huggingface-hub<1.0,>=0.33.5`) are shown in your forum post.
